Name: Bye Bye Butterfly
Author: suzukiPC
Description:
[b][size=5]Why?[/size]
[/b]
I made this mod for my friend who has a phobia of butterflies. I figured, "It shouldn't be that hard right? I just have to re-texture the existing butterflies." But then I realized, "Oh no, we have an item that SPAWNS them, the Butterfly Hutch," so that furniture item also got a retexture.

[size=5][b]What does it do?[/b][/size]

This mod affects the butterflies you see out in the open world and the ones that spawn from the hutch. Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] you can select to change the butterflies to Petals, Stars, or Snowflakes﻿. Choosing None completely eradicates them, as well as the Butterfly Hutch from the desert trader in Calico Desert. 

[size=5][b]1.1 Keep Butterflies Update
[/b][/size]
Players now have a toggle to keep the butterflies, checking the box in the GMCM settings lets you keep the butterflies and have the Butterfly Hutch reskin.
[size=4]
[/size][size=4][i]NOTE: [/i]If you have [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] and you try to look up the Butterfly Hutch with my mod installed, it will not show up if you type [b][Butterfly Hutch][/b], because I renamed the item depending on what option you picked.[/size]

[size=3][b]﻿Petals             -->    Petal Producer
[/b][/size][size=3][b]Stars               -->    Star Spawner
Snowflakes    -->    Snow Shaker
Bats ﻿ ﻿  -->    Mini Bat Cave
Hearts ﻿     -->    Heart Spinner
Eggs ﻿ ﻿ -->    Egg basket
UFO ﻿ ﻿  -->    Command Center
Jellyfish  ﻿-->    Jellyquarium
Magma Sprites  -->  Magma Kiln
Ghosts ﻿    -->    Ghost Gate
Skulls ﻿      -->   Skull Summoner
None               -->    [i]literally does not show up

[/i][/b][/size]This mod applies retroactively because it's just a retexture. I've considered maybe there's people out there who are playing with friends and family who may have bought the butterfly hutch but are keeping quiet about their phobia or discomfort to keep the peace, this is why I offered options apart from [b]None[/b] so you don't have to look at a floating error icon xD It won't interfere with co-op gameplay, the people you play with that doesn't have the mod installed will still keep seeing butterflies.

On that note, no, you cannot have all three versions displayed at once; they are not separate items. I've thought about making them stand-alone furniture items in the future, but making particles (like the butterflies) seems to be a hard-coded thing, and I'm not that experienced yet. Maybe someday hehe

[size=5][b]Compatibilities
[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature in the Valley[/url] - Using my mod to replace the vanilla butterflies or completely hide them with the [None] option will make it so that you don't confuse vanilla butterflies with Nature in the Valley's catchable butterflies

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11166]Better Butterfly Hutch[/url] - You can have more butterfly replacements floating about :D

[size=5][b]Other Notes
[/b][/size]
I personally had [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1965]Elle's Town Animals[/url] installed and noticed my retexture for the butterflies were not working. Thanks to my friend [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/aviroen]Aviroen[/url] they found that it's because of priority loading. Currently my mod is set to load late, after +100 mods have loaded in to make sure the changes apply. If you somehow have more than that you can come into the content.json and change it to a bigger number; just look for [code]﻿"Priority" : "Late +100",
[/code]﻿apply your edit, and save.

The mod doesn't really change the behaviour of the particles depending on what you pick, so the retextures follow the behaviour of the butterflies (the Petals option will look faster than the regular petals and leaves for example). Until I learn how to mess around with that you'll just have to accept the erratic and bouncy movement x)

Please feel free to suggest more texture replacements in the comments :)

Also has the new toggle to let you keep butterflies and still use the butterfly hutch retextures
